provenance.sourceAccessMethod: This guide uses the full retained run HTML, dated source ledger and verification JSON only. No external research, price refresh, browser interaction or benchmark rerun during authoring.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: The original clean-browser constraint was not fully maintained: early host-tool fetch failures used the existing managed browser; search fallback receipts included managed/research and ordinary-Chrome lanes without established clean-session status. Failed fallback pages were not product evidence. No account was intentionally opened, authenticated or inspected; no stored credentials were requested or extracted; no purchase, basket action or contact was performed. Later direct requests used no Cookie/Authorization headers or credential materialisation; later review reading and visual checks used fresh non-persistent Chrome contexts without importing sign-ins.
provenance.publicationDates: Retailer/manufacturer offer pages generally undated. Review, guidance and document dates are retained separately in prose; access dates do not establish publication or offer-update dates.

datePolicy: Every cited source has retained access/index observation date 2026-11-06 per the source ledger, including failed retailer offer confirmation. Those dates do not imply successful direct access for indexed/blocked pages. Authoring on 2026-11-07 does not refresh facts. January 2027 prices and availability remain unknown.
uncertainties: One exact laptop offer directly checked, three Windows watch-list candidates only. John Lewis stock indication did not include Bristol postcode checkout or reservation.

Legion £1,299 conflicts with indexed category £1,499; live price, stock, sale dates, charger, delivered price, panel measurements, GPU power, upgrade topology, ports, weight, battery and noise remain unconfirmed.
A14 £1,249.99 family starting price is not confirmed for FA401KM RTX 5060. Stock and regional adapter inclusion unresolved; 16GB is soldered. UK GPU specification 105W differs from review 110W.

Nitro £1,099 live offer and NH.U3PEK.00M consumer-SKU linkage unconfirmed; panel accuracy, travel specifications and measured noise incomplete. Price-history dates are retailer statements, not independently tracked lows.

X9 £199.99 is provisional indexed evidence, not a confirmed retailer delivered offer. Air £1,457.99 and Legion £1,498.99 totals remain conditional; reader £20 is an allowance. No Studio licence or RAM upgrade budgeted.
Apple generic HEVC engine and Adobe Premiere guidance do not establish M5 Resolve Sony 4:2:2 performance. Exact clips, installed edition, proxies, grade, export and relinking need testing.

Windows Free edition codec restrictions are separate from GPU processing. RTX 50 architecture evidence does not certify every 5050/5060 laptop/application path. Studio does not repair missing hardware profiles.
Resolve Free output assumption is UHD 3840×2160 at up to 60fps with actual preset test; not DCI 4096-wide, higher frame rate or every codec. Codec PDF has a broad >=4K Studio-only encoding footnote.

Review measurements are individual samples; no comparable same-version PugetBench Resolve or native Sony timeline FPS dataset. Browsing/video battery tests are not editing runtimes; no invented noise dBA or HDR certification.

January discounts, SKU continuity, final seller, UK keyboard, warranty, return terms and delivery unconfirmed. Education eligibility not established by age or freelance status. External working SSD is not a backup.
editingContract: New English Markdown and matching schema-v2 record only, with optional assigned self-review note. No Chinese audience established. No shared files, source-run files or existing pages edited; no build, external research, purchase or publication. Body external URL registry has exact set coverage; source hashes checked read-only.
